title: Define stable GitHub Release asset contract
description: Define predictable standalone executable names for every supported OS and architecture, published checksum metadata, the GitHub latest-release lookup contract, and the platform-to-asset mapping shared by release automation and wtp update.

comments.author: Codex
comments.message: Defined the stable release contract in internal/releaseasset and docs: six Darwin/Linux/Windows AMD64/ARM64 standalone asset names, strict SHA-256 checksum metadata parsing, and the versioned GitHub latest-release API shape. GoReleaser now publishes that exact matrix as uncompressed binaries plus checksums.txt, with tests locking automation to the shared mapping. Verified with scripts/check.sh, scripts/check.ps1, go vet ./..., six direct cross-builds, GoReleaser v2.17.0 check, and a snapshot artifact/checksum comparison.
